source.title: Plaguelands Rendezvous
source.description:
Of course I expected you to find me here. Why do you think I left those cultist's corpses for you to find in that vault?

Before you get too worked up; yes the orb is safe. More safe than this city, apparently. If I had entered the vault just a few moments later the orb would have been long gone.

I've said enough for now and this tavern has ears. Find me on the Island of Caer Darrow in Western Plaguelands. You'll get answers when you arrive.
source.objective: Find Ada Darkhardt at Caer Darrow in Western Plaguelands.
source.completion:
I sense the end is in sight. Hopefully we can find a suitable replacement for your blood, and be done with this business once and for all.

In any case, you came all this way in good faith and didn't try to kill me so I appreciate that. Here, take this as a token of my appreciation. It's not much, but it served me well... in another life. Hopefully it can be a boon to you as well.
